# Michael Kaminski

> Technical product manager working at the agent layer. Builds AI agents that run in
> production — custom MCP servers, multi-agent pipelines, and eval harnesses in Python
> and TypeScript. Took an AI agent capability from prototype through security, legal, and
> compliance review inside a regulated lender. Atlanta, relocating to New York City.

## Who he is

Michael Kaminski is a technical product manager who builds AI agent infrastructure. He is
currently Senior Product Owner, Collections & Servicing at Stellantis Financial Services US;
the AI agent work is scope inside that role, not the title.

What is unusual about him is the combination: he can price a system and he can ship it.
Before working at the agent layer he spent years in corporate finance and strategy, and he
has authored Terraform modules with multi-environment remote state and operated production
Kubernetes clusters.

## What he works on

- Agentic workflow design and multi-agent orchestration
- Custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
- Tool design an agent can actually call
- Eval harness design, including statistical gating for agent instruction changes
- Human approval gates on irreversible agent actions
- Retrieval-augmented generation, LLM application architecture
- Python, TypeScript, Terraform, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL

## Selected experience

- Stellantis Financial Services — Senior Product Owner, Collections & Servicing (present).
  Owns a voice-AI initiative evaluating multi-agent orchestration options.
- Google — Agentic Researcher, Engineering, Core PMO (Oct–Dec 2025).
- Momnt — Tech lead, Credit Analysis & Accounting Engine (2023–2024). Delivery
  accountability, not people management.
- Modular Equity — Executive investment vehicle he manages (2023–present).
- GreenSky — fintech; product, credit and strategy (2016–).
- HD Supply — Sr. Analyst, Strategic Finance (2015–2016). Supported a $1.8B divestiture
  program, built a $244M branch-network hub-and-spoke DCF, modeled a comp-arbitrage case for
  relocating roughly 2,000 roles, and ran portfolio analytics on a $500M CapEx program.
- KPMG — Senior Consultant, Advisory (2014–2015). Eight engagements, $300M in client tax savings.
- The Home Depot — career origin (2011–2014).
- Superior Contracting & Maintenance — founder, still operating; roughly $20M revenue/yr.

## Education

- MBA, Georgia State University (2011).
- BS, Computer Science, DeVry University (2008).
